decisions.label: SUPPORTED

numbers.quote: Structure-controlled news summarization on the test data of Dataset D (the paper's new news-summary dataset).

decisions.rationale: T1 evaluates test data from Dataset D and reports a single run per system; no other evaluated dataset is identified.

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: Content evidence is mixed: beam Method M has lower ROUGE-L than two baselines but higher FactCC and AlignScore. T1 therefore does not establish an overall content-accuracy trade-off.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: Fine-tuned LLaMa-3-8B scored 22.01% versus 47.18% for vanilla LLaMa-3-8B, a descriptively large reduction of 25.17 percentage points.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The edit variant's human Match Score was 0.24 versus 0.55 for the beam variant, making “much lower” a calibrated description of the large observed difference.

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: ROUGE-L was 15.28% for the edit variant and 42.98% for the beam variant; the 27.70-point gap supports the descriptive term “substantially lower.”

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1 reports 0.59 and 0.64, but provides no variance, test, or similarity criterion establishing that the two FactCC results are similar.
